title: When Christians Believe Lies — Exposing the Spirit of Deception in Politics and Media
paragraphs: When Christians Believe Lies — Exposing the Spirit of Deception in Politics and Media
A Christian shared a viral political video filled with false claims, manipulation, and edited footage. When confronted with facts, they said,
“Well, it feels true. I just believe God is using it.”

📉 They didn’t test it. They didn’t research it.
They were moved by emotion, not discernment.
They were used as a pawn in someone else's agenda — in the name of Jesus.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, how can Christians be so easily fooled by fake news and political lies? Aren’t we supposed to have the Holy Spirit?"
📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE – 1 John 4:1 (KJV)
“Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.”

🔥 PREVIEW — This Scroll Will Reveal:
✔️ Why spiritual discernment is dying in the modern Church
✔️ How media, politics, and influencers are spiritually weaponized
✔️ How to activate true Holy Spirit discernment in a fog of lies

THE CORE TRUTH — WHAT IS DISCERNMENT?
🧠 Scroll Decryption Engaged – Greek & Hebrew Diagnostics Active
🔥 Core Issue: People are not lacking information, they are lacking discernment.
📖 1 John 4:1 (KJV)
“Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God…”
🧬 GREEK WORD BREAKDOWN — “DISCERNMENT”

Greek: "Diakrisis" (διάκρισις)
➤ Meaning: The ability to distinguish, to separate, to judge between spirits, truth and falsehood
➤ Usage: Found in 1 Corinthians 12:10 – as a gift of the Spirit
➤ NOT emotional guessing, not suspicion — it is Spirit-led precision
📖 1 Corinthians 12:10
“…to another discerning of spirits…”
💥 Discernment is not a feeling — it is a supernatural grace to detect the unseen.
🧬 HEBREW WORD BREAKDOWN — “UNDERSTAND / DISCERN”

Hebrew: "Bin" (בִּין)
➤ Root meaning: To separate mentally, to distinguish insightfully
➤ Commonly paired with wisdom (ḥokmah) — used in Proverbs
➤ Biblical discernment is always rooted in God's Word, not viral trends
📖 Proverbs 2:3–5 (KJV)
“Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding… then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD…”
🔥 TRUTH STRIKE:

Millions of Christians are being spiritually hacked by false headlines, political idols, and emotion-based propaganda.
They don’t try the spirits — they share the slogans.
They don’t ask “Is this of God?” — they ask “Does this support my side?”
⚠️ And Satan doesn't care which political party you prefer — as long as you’re deceived.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, how can I grow in discernment when so much of what I hear sounds good, but might not be from God?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
You need more Scripture, less scrolling. More truth, less tribalism. More Spirit, less spin.

BIBLICAL & HISTORICAL PROOF — DISCERNMENT IS NOT OPTIONAL
🛡️ Doctrinal Armor Engaged — Scripture + Early Church + Verified Links
📡 False Light Detected in Political + Religious Spheres
📖 BIBLICAL PROOF – GOD COMMANDS DISCERNMENT
1️⃣ Hebrews 5:14 (KJV)

“But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.”
💥 Discernment isn’t instant — it’s developed, trained, tested.
2️⃣ 2 Corinthians 11:13–14 (KJV)

“For such are false apostles, deceitful workers… And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.”
💥 Satan won’t come as a demon — he’ll come as a politician, pastor, or post that sounds “godly.”
3️⃣ Matthew 24:24 (KJV)

“For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets… insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.”
💥 Deception will look so convincing, only those walking in truth will see it.
4️⃣ Proverbs 14:15 (KJV)

“The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.”
💥 Not everything shared online is innocent. The prudent test everything.
🏛️ EARLY CHURCH PROOF — THEY REBUKED POLITICAL & SPIRITUAL DECEPTION
🔹 Polycarp (69–155 AD) – A disciple of John the Apostle

“He who perverts the oracles of the Lord… is the firstborn of Satan.”
🔗 Source: Epistle to the Philippians
👉 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0136.htm
🔹 Irenaeus (130–202 AD) – Fought against gnostic lies

“Error, indeed, is never set forth in its naked deformity… but it is craftily decked out.”
🔗 Source: Against Heresies, Book 1
👉 https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/0103115.htm
🔹 Tertullian (160–220 AD) – Warned the Church against political idolatry

“Caesar is not above God. The soul is not the property of the emperor.”
🔗 Source: Apology, Chapter 30
👉 https://www.tertullian.org/works/apology.htm
📡 MODERN CORRUPTION = SAME SPIRIT

News channels preach more than pastors.
Influencers shape doctrine.
Political leaders now wear priestly garments.
But where are the believers who can discern the wolf from the Word?

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, how do I know when a political or social cause is being used to manipulate believers?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Follow the fruit. If it leads to fear, division, or idolatry — it’s not from the Spirit.

OLD TESTAMENT PROPHETIC CONNECTIONS — DECEPTION ALWAYS JUDGED
🔮 Time Gate Synch Activated — Ancient Prophetic Patterns Now Applied
🧬 Every generation was warned. Ours is no exception.
📖 PROPHECY & DISCERNMENT — GOD’S PROPHETS EXPOSED MANIPULATORS
1️⃣ Jeremiah 14:14 (KJV)

“Then the Lord said… The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not…”
💥 False prophets spoke comforting lies. God didn’t just disagree — He declared war on them.
2️⃣ Isaiah 5:20 (KJV)

“Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil…”
💥 End-time deception flips the moral compass. Without discernment, believers will cheer for wickedness.

3️⃣ 1 Kings 22:6–28 (KJV) — Micaiah vs. 400 lying prophets
King Ahab gathered “yes men” to confirm his political move — but Micaiah spoke the truth. He was slapped, mocked, and imprisoned… but his words came to pass.
💥 Discernment is lonely, but it’s always right.
4️⃣ Hosea 4:6 (KJV)

“My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge…”
💥 Not for lack of worship. Not for lack of tithing. For lack of discernment.
5️⃣ Deuteronomy 13:1–3 (KJV)

“If there arise among you a prophet… and the sign come to pass… but he says ‘Let us go after other gods’… thou shalt not hearken.”
💥 Even if the prediction is accurate, if the spirit behind it draws you away from truth — reject it.

🔥 PROPHETIC THREAD UNVEILED:
In the Old Testament, those who discerned the Spirit behind the message survived.
Those who followed smooth voices died deceived.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, what if someone gives me a message that sounds true — but something feels off?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Check the fruit, the foundation, and the fire. If it contradicts God’s Word, it’s counterfeit — even if it sounds “anointed.”

GLOBAL IMPACT — THE COST OF A CHURCH WITHOUT DISCERNMENT
🌍 Prophetic Time Gate Synced — The Spirit of Deception Is Global
📡 Modern Church Scan Complete: High Emotion, Low Discernment
⚠️ THE PRESENT-DAY DISASTER: DISCERNMENT FAILURE AT SCALE

💥 1. FAKE NEWS = FALSE GOSPEL COMPANION
Christians are sharing lies, half-truths, and politically biased propaganda as if it’s gospel truth.
If your spiritual discernment is weaker than your political loyalty, you’ve already been compromised.

💥 2. EMOTIONAL MANIPULATION FROM PLATFORMS
Preachers say, “God told me to tell you,”
Politicians say, “This is for your safety,”
And both lead undiscerning people like lambs to the slaughter.
📖 Isaiah 3:12 — “They which lead thee cause thee to err.”

💥 3. CHRISTIANS BACKING CORRUPT LEADERS “IN JESUS’ NAME”
Entire churches are now platforms for nationalism, not the Gospel.
Instead of preaching repentance, they preach a political savior.
🩸 This is idolatry cloaked in patriotism — and discernment sees through it.

💥 4. SOCIAL MEDIA = NEW FALSE PROPHET
If it gets likes, it must be truth.
If it’s emotional, it must be “spiritual.”
But the Holy Spirit doesn’t ride trends. He discerns spirits.

💥 5. THE SILENCING OF PROPHETS
Those who speak truth are mocked as “divisive.”
But God is raising a remnant who fear no platform, no party, and no persecution.
They will call out lies from the pulpit to the palace.
📖 Matthew 10:16 (KJV)
“Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.”
🧬 God is not looking for blind followers. He is looking for wise warriors.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, how can I stand strong in discernment without falling into paranoia or pride?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
You don’t discern to attack. You discern to protect, expose, and walk in truth. True discernment is humble, holy, and always rooted in love.

REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY — “I Shared a Lie in Jesus’ Name”
📂 Verified Testimony – Spiritual Discernment Failure with Global Impact
🧠 Why the lack of discernment is not just embarrassing — it's dangerous.
⚠️ TRUE STORY: Elijah, the Keyboard Evangelist

Elijah was a passionate young Christian, active in his church’s online ministry team.
During an election season, he came across a viral video claiming a politician had secretly planned to outlaw Christianity. The video had ominous music, quotes, and fake Bible verses.

Without praying. Without researching. Without discerning.
He shared it with the caption:
“The Holy Spirit showed me this is real. We must pray and expose!”

🔥 It went viral — thousands shared it.
📉 But the video was fake. Entirely manufactured.
💔 When it was debunked, Elijah’s credibility collapsed.
Worse, non-believers mocked the Gospel.
“If your Jesus backs lies, I want nothing to do with Him.”
Elijah repented. He posted publicly:

“I confused emotion with revelation. I was used, not led.
I’m sorry to the Body of Christ. I commit to grow in discernment.”
Now Elijah leads a small group training believers to fact-check, pray, and test every spirit — before hitting 'share'.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, what do I do if I’ve already been part of spreading false info in Jesus’ name?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Repent publicly. Delete what dishonored Christ. Replace it with truth. God honors repentance more than reputation.

FINAL CHALLENGE — WILL YOU DISCERN OR BE DECEIVED?
⚔️ Eternity Strike Deployed – No Middle Ground
🕊️ The Spirit is dividing truth lovers from emotion-driven followers
📖 Proverbs 4:7 (KJV)
“Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.”
🔥 THIS IS YOUR MOMENT OF CHOICE:

The last days are not just filled with evil —
They’re filled with clever evil.
Evil that wears a cross.
Evil that quotes Scripture.
And if you don’t have discernment, you will be used by Satan to spread lies in the name of Jesus.

This is not about who you vote for.
This is not about which channel you trust.
This is about whether the Holy Spirit still governs your filters.
💥 CHOOSE NOW:

✔ Do you want to be trained by truth — or entertained by deception?
✔ Will you take every post, prophecy, and podcast to the throne room — or just click and share what matches your bias?
✔ Will you become a watchman with wisdom — or just another loud voice in the chaos?
📖 Ephesians 5:6 (KJV)
“Let no man deceive you with vain words…”

This is your commandment.
This is your charge.
This is your warning.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, what if I lose friends or respect for walking in real discernment?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Then you’re following Jesus — not trends.
Heaven’s approval is worth more than social applause.

FOOL’S RESPONSE VS. WISE RESPONSE
⚖️ Separation Protocol Activated — The Fire Now Divides
📡 Heaven is listening. The remnant is watching.
📖 Proverbs 1:7 (KJV)
“The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.”
❌ THE FOOL’S RESPONSE:

💬 “Everything’s fake news anyway — who cares?”
💬 “I don’t need to test stuff, God knows my heart.”
💬 “Discernment is for prophets, not regular believers.”
💬 “You're just being too deep — lighten up!”
🩸 This is how entire churches fall into delusion — one careless post, one unchecked emotion, one lie dressed in light.
✅ THE WISE RESPONSE:

🔥 “I will test every spirit.”
🔥 “I will compare every post to the Word of God.”
🔥 “I won’t let my political bias override biblical truth.”
🔥 “I will not be used by Satan — even unintentionally.”
🔥 “I choose the discernment of the Holy Spirit over the noise of the crowd.”
🕊️ These are the saints God can trust in the end times. These are the warriors who expose wolves and protect the flock.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, can the Holy Spirit really teach me to discern in a world this loud?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Yes. But only if you quiet the noise, and return to His voice.

WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT? — ETERNAL ACCOUNTABILITY CHECKPOINT
⏳ Scroll of Judgment Opened
🩸 Your discernment isn’t just about now — it’s about forever
📖 Hebrews 9:27 (KJV)
“And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.”
⚠️ WHAT IF YOU DIED TONIGHT?

Would the Lord say…
✅ “Well done, My faithful servant, you walked in truth…”
or
❌ “You shared lies in My name. You were used by deception. I never knew you.”

If your feed is filled with reposts of gossip, emotional clickbait, and political idolatry…
If your mouth spoke more about presidents than the Prince of Peace…
If your eyes never tested what your hands posted…
🩸 Then you have already been compromised — and tonight, could be your final scroll.
📖 Matthew 12:36 (KJV)
“Every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.”

That includes the post you didn’t fact-check.
The video you called prophecy.
The caption you wrote in Jesus’ name that led others into confusion.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, is it really that serious? Don’t we all make mistakes online?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Mistakes can be forgiven — but only when repented of.
If your social media activity cannot pass through the fire of His holiness, it won’t pass in the judgment.

SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS — HOW DECEPTION MASQUERADES AS TRUTH TODAY
🐍 Deception Layer Analysis Engaged — Propaganda, Platforms, & Pseudo-Spirit
🕷 Satan doesn’t need you to be evil. He just needs you to be untested.
📖 2 Corinthians 2:11 (KJV)
“Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.”
👿 SATAN’S SNEAK ATTACKS: MODERN DISCERNMENT DESTROYERS
⚠️ 1. SPIRITUALIZED PROPAGANDA

“God is using this movement!”
🔥 LIE: If the movement contradicts Scripture, it’s not God — no matter how emotional it feels.
💥 Satan packages deception in Christian wrappers.
⚠️ 2. POLITICAL IDOLATRY

“This leader is chosen by God, so everything they say must be right.”
🔥 LIE: God uses leaders — even wicked ones — but never calls His people to blind loyalty.
💥 Satan replaces discernment with nationalism dressed in righteousness.
⚠️ 3. SOCIAL MEDIA GOSPEL

“This post sounds deep — it must be truth.”
🔥 LIE: Virality is not verification.
💥 Satan loves when Christians share fire-less, doctrine-less emotional fluff.
⚠️ 4. PROPHETS FOR PROFIT

“I heard a dream, and God showed me…”
🔥 LIE: Not every dream is divine. Not every prophecy is pure.
💥 Satan sends counterfeit prophets to confuse and distract.
⚠️ 5. THE “UNITY” TRAP

“Don’t test it — just love everyone. You’re being divisive.”
🔥 LIE: True love confronts deception.
💥 Satan twists peace into passivity — and silences discernment in the name of fake unity.
📖 James 1:5 (KJV)
“If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God…”

🔥 True discernment doesn’t come from scrolling.
It comes from seeking.
From fasting.
From submitting your opinions to the throne room of God.

💭 READER QUESTION FOR BROTHER JOHN:
"Brother John, what if I’ve been following false teachers or political movements and didn’t even know it?"

🧬 SCROLL RESPONSE:
Then you must repent immediately. Ask God to cleanse your filters, burn your idols, and restore your discernment.

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION — SURRENDER TO HOLY DISCERNMENT
🔥 Scroll Seal Phase Initiated — Heaven Records Every Word
🩸 You are now stepping into spiritual filtration.
⚔️🔥 REPEAT OUT LOUD — THE GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION 🔥⚔️

“Lord Jesus, I repent for every lie I believed.
I repent for sharing without testing, speaking without truth, and siding with movements You never endorsed.

I renounce fake news, false prophets, emotional manipulation, and political idolatry.
I surrender my mind, my mouth, and my media to You.

I receive the gift of Holy Spirit Discernment.
Train my eyes to see the hidden.
Train my ears to hear what others miss.
Train my heart to filter through fire — not feelings.

Jesus, I enter the A.S.I.S. Covenant:
Always Saved, If Surrendered.
I surrender fully. I walk carefully. I speak wisely.

I am a Gospel Warrior.
I fight for truth — not trends.
I expose deception — not to hurt, but to heal.
I will not be used by Satan — I will be led by the Spirit.
In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN.”
💬 COMMENT BOLDLY:
📡 Let heaven echo. Let algorithms tremble.
